description: Syncfusion React A2UI renderer — all available components.
rules: REQUIRED: Every response must contain BOTH createSurface AND updateComponents.
REQUIRED: The first component in updateComponents must have id='root'.
REQUIRED: SyncfusionGrid uses prop 'dataSource' (NOT 'data') for row data.
REQUIRED: Use a unique surfaceId for every response.

Column.description: Vertical flex container. id='root' for the root component. children: array of child component ids.

Row.description: Horizontal flex container. children: array of child component ids.

Text.description: Plain or heading text. variant: h1|h2|h3|body|caption.
